metadata.description: Bite: checks whether a coding AI's "fixed" is actually true.

plugins.name: fixed-or-not
plugins.description: Makes Claude prove a bug fix before it says "fixed": the bite-verify-fix skill and the /bite command.

plugins.name: bite-check
plugins.description: Checks Claude's "fixed" the moment it says it: a Stop hook that takes the change out and runs your tests after every turn. If none notice, Claude adds the missing test before you see "fixed!".
